text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Good work. I observed your training
with great interest.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: That cooldown method in particular is something I'd like to incorporate going forward.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Which means we'll need to reorganize the training routine...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Something just came up, so I'll be taking my leave.
